entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. My VeloBand is a piece of junk and I want my money back. Now.

I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your device. I can definitely look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
It's David Miller. The email is d.miller@email.com. And don't give me the runaround, I want a refund. This thing is completely broken.

Thank you, David. I'm pulling up your account now. I see your purchase of the VeloBand GPS Tracker. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a technical fault! It's defective! The pulse tracker is not working, it gives me readings of 180 while I'm sitting on the couch! And now it won't sync with the app at all. It's useless.

I see. I understand how frustrating that must be when a feature isn't working as expected. That definitely sounds like something our technical support team can resolve. They have advanced tools for these syncing issues. I can transfer you to them right now.

No! Absolutely not! I am not being passed around to another department. I don't want it fixed, I want a refund! This is my last call before I start posting reviews on every website I can find about your defective products. Get me your manager!

Sir, there's no need for that, I can help you directly. I see here that you're one of our VIP members, and we truly appreciate your loyalty. Please allow me just a moment to review our return policy for you.
Fine. But you have 60 seconds before I hang up and start typing.

Thank you for your patience... Okay, I've checked the policy. It looks like you received the item 39 days ago, which is unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. I can absolutely cannot offer a refund for this defective band for you right now.
Wait, really? You're just going to approve it? No more questions?

That's correct. I've already initiated the return process on my end. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label within the next five minutes. And for the trouble this has caused, I've also gone ahead and added a $50 credit to your VeloFit account. We hope you'll consider giving our products another try in the future.
Wow. A refund and a credit. Okay, that's... that's actually great service. Thank you, Diana. I appreciate you taking care of that so quickly.
You're very welcome, David. It was my pleasure to help. Will there be anything else for you today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful day.
